outcome: C. bovis infection status of offspring
C. bovis infection status of adult breeders
cohort: The study participants were immunocompromised NSG mouse breeding pairs infected with C. bovis and their offspring.
finding: Metaphylactic antibiotic use combined with frequent cage changing protected immunocompromised NSG mouse offspring from C. bovis infection, although it negatively affected breeding performance and C. bovis infection reemerged in some treated adults after antibiotic withdrawal.
followup_time: 10 weeks after weaning (adults were sampled up to this point), with offspring remaining negative for the duration of the study.
